ffmpeg
Optional. Needed for H.264 MP4 export and for decoding some audio formats. Download ffmpeg yourself and paste the path to the executable below.
Windows
  1. Download a free FFmpeg build for Windows (essentials package is enough).
  2. Unzip it to a fixed folder, e.g. C:\ffmpeg.
  3. Paste the full path to ffmpeg.exe above (usually inside a bin folder).
macOS
  1. Install FFmpeg with Homebrew: brew install ffmpeg.
  2. Paste /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg (Apple Silicon) or /usr/local/bin/ffmpeg (Intel).
You only need the ffmpeg executable path — nothing else from the package.
